hf.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
hf.abstract: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.
hf.titleZh: Jeveration：系统一模型现在也能生成图像
hf.summaryZh: 探索用系统一（System One）式的并行预测在单次前向中生成高质量图像：以冻结的视觉语言模型为基础，复用其视觉—语义知识完成整体生成。为让并行预测收敛到连贯整体，该方法把所有位置条件化在同一个共享随机状态上，使每次采样得到不同但自洽的图像；由于直接以图像监督时模型容易忽略该状态，作者先学习离散图像码的分布来引导单次生成。同一架构还统一了文生图、图生图与稠密预测，一个 checkpoint 覆盖三类任务且均为一次前向；512×512 图像生成耗时 78ms，比现有统一模型最快快 122 倍，图像质量与稠密预测性能保持竞争力。
hf.reason: 图像生成属低分方向，仅与 VLM 架构复用略有交集

hf.title: Tideway: Phase-Aware Tiered Memory Management for MoE Inference on Consumer Devices
hf.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly becoming a dominant paradigm for AI applications. Recently, there is a growing demand to deploy large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models locally on consumer PCs to balance data privacy, API costs, and inference efficiency. However, unlike datacenter servers with abundant DRAM, consumer devices are tightly constrained in both GPU VRAM and host RAM, forcing massive MoE weights to spill across VRAM, host RAM, and SSD. Under such spilling, we observe that existing systems fail to fully utilize this memory hierarchy, treating the tiers as independent caches and thrashing in inference. We present TIDEWAY, a system for efficient inference of large MoE models on memory-constrained consumer devices. Our core insight is to manage host RAM and GPU VRAM as a unified memory pool. Within this pool, TIDEWAY couples phase-aware memory layouts, which adapt to the distinct access patterns of prefill and decode, with an execution engine that optimizes CUDA Graph execution under expert paging. Our evaluations on representative consumer hardware with frontier MoE models demonstrate that TIDEWAY significantly outperforms state-of-the-art systems. On average, TIDEWAY achieves speedups of 1.97x in end-to-end latency and 2.40x in Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), along with 1.61x higher decode throughput against the fastest baseline. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Afterglow231/Tideway .
hf.titleZh: Tideway：面向消费级设备上 MoE 推理的相位感知分层内存管理
hf.summaryZh: 消费级 PC 的显存与内存难以容纳大规模 MoE 权重，权重被迫在 VRAM、主机 RAM 与 SSD 之间换出，而现有系统把各层当作独立缓存，导致推理抖动、内存层次利用率低。Tideway 将主机 RAM 与 GPU VRAM 统一为单一内存池，配合分别适配 prefill 与 decode 访问模式的相位感知内存布局，以及针对专家分页场景优化 CUDA Graph 执行的执行引擎。在代表性消费级硬件与前沿 MoE 模型上，端到端延迟平均加速 1.97 倍，首 token 时间加速 2.40 倍，解码吞吐较最快基线提升 1.61 倍。该工作为本地私有化部署大模型提供了可落地的系统方案。
hf.reason: MoE 推理系统与分层内存优化，属高效推理方向，结果扎实

hf.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
hf.abstract: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.
hf.titleZh: ALIVE:让流式视频模型具备交互能力
hf.summaryZh: 流式视频 LLM 虽能持续观察世界，却往往对用户请求做孤立响应。为此构建 ALIVE-SFT-288K 与 ALIVE-RL-3K 做两阶段训练:对比式监督微调教会模型何时、如何回应，再用带行为对齐信用分配(BACA)的强化学习融合轨迹级与局部优势，在多轮交互中优化决策、回复与沉默;同时提出 FSI-Bench 评测主动寻求反馈及后续任务完成。ALIVE 在四个公开基准与 FSI-Bench 上总分居对比模型之首。
hf.reason: 流式视频 LLM 的多轮交互与 RL 后训练，命中后训练与多模态理解

hf.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
hf.abstract: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.
hf.titleZh: 分辨力假设：Agent进化的关键在于识别改进
hf.summaryZh: Agent进化靠proposer生成候选prompt、skill、memory，再由selection保留高分项，但不同方法在论文间互有胜负，部分任务上难以自我启动。核心论点是“分辨力假设”：瓶颈不在候选生成，而在噪声评估无法可靠识别改进；用7种进化方法、6个模型、超1000万次LLM调用验证，候选层面有用artifact存在，但选择区分有用与有害候选不优于随机，误差逐轮累积；方法层面几个百分点的领先小于同一方法两次独立运行的差异，排名常靠运气。由此需把自我改进智能体的研发与评测，从设计更多候选改进系统转向让真实改进可检测、可累积。
hf.reason: 系统实证Agent进化瓶颈在评估分辨力，直击自我改进与评测方向

hf.title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
hf.abstract: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection. With Game2Player, we build 568 verified web games with 3,436 tasks, collect 15.7K trajectories (307 hours of gameplay), and hold out 50 games as the benchmark PlayerBench. To evaluate the collected experience as training data, we train VLM agents with progress-weighted SFT, assigning greater weight to steps that advance task progress. Game2Player-9B improves progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on PlayerBench and from 30.0% to 53.1% on the external GameWorld benchmark. More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.
hf.titleZh: Game2Player:通过环境与玩家协同开发扩展视觉智能体的游戏体验
hf.summaryZh: 针对视觉智能体缺乏可验证游戏交互数据的问题，提出环境与玩家协同开发的框架:Builder 智能体改造现有网页游戏、暴露内部状态，并定义带状态进度度量与成功判定的任务;Coding Player 与 VLM Player 试玩后向 Builder 回报问题并修复，使试玩同时完成环境校验与数据采集。据此构建 568 个经校验的网页游戏、3,436 个任务，采集 15.7K 条轨迹(307 小时游戏时长)，并留出 50 个游戏作为 PlayerBench。以进度加权 SFT 训练 VLM 智能体，Game2Player-9B 在 PlayerBench 上把任务进度从 14.3% 提升到 31.2%，在外部 GameWorld 上从 30.0% 提升到 53.1%。
hf.reason: Agent 环境合成与 VLM 智能体训练，系统性强

hf.title: PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling
hf.abstract: High-resolution weather prediction is important for resolving local atmospheric patterns missed by coarse global forecasts. Large pretrained weather backbones have improved global forecasting, but adapting them to produce future high-resolution fields from recent coarse states remains challenging and costly. We formulate this setting as Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling (PSWD), a task that jointly refines spatial and temporal resolution while predicting future high-resolution trajectories. To this end, we propose a framework that decomposes prediction into spatial and temporal stages using a shared pretrained backbone, fixed numerical scaffolds, and lightweight residual heads. For backbone adaptation, we introduce PROLA (PRincipal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation), which allocates a fixed low-rank budget between pretrained weights' principal directions and their orthogonal complement. PROLA further rescales rank-1 optimizer updates using gradient signals, improving adaptation without increasing trainable rank. Experiments in the PSWD setting show that PROLA outperforms representative low-rank adaptation baselines. Further experiments across diverse datasets and tasks support the broader applicability of PROLA, showing that its benefits extend beyond the primary weather downscaling setting.
hf.titleZh: PROLA：用于预测性时空天气降尺度的主方向正交低秩适配
hf.summaryZh: 针对从近期粗分辨率状态同时预测未来高分辨率时空场的问题，将一个共享预训练天气骨干、固定数值支架（fixed numerical scaffolds）与轻量残差头组合，拆成空间与时间两阶段完成预测；并指出适配该骨干时的低秩预算分配问题。PROLA 将固定的低秩预算分配给预训练权重的主方向及其正交补，并利用梯度信号对 rank-1 优化器更新重新缩放，在不增加可训练秩的前提下提升适配效果。在预测性时空天气降尺度设定下，PROLA 优于代表性低秩适配基线，并在多数据集、多任务上验证了收益可外推到天气以外的场景。
hf.reason: 低秩适配方法有参考价值，但主战场是气象降尺度，方向偏应用

hf.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
hf.abstract: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
hf.titleZh: CurvDelta：面向精准学习与遗忘的低曲率增量建模
hf.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 适配中目标能力提升却损害通用能力的问题，将保持约束写入参数更新本身：围绕适配前模型分析约束的局部几何，构造使保持损失近似不变的低曲率子空间，并用 Kronecker 分解近似曲率（K-FAC）与因子化投影扩展到 LLM，同时给出低秩变体 CurvLoRA。在数学推理与代码生成上取得有竞争力的下游表现并更好保持通用能力；在 TOFU、MUSE 的遗忘任务上，目标遗忘与知识保持的平衡优于基线，保持性能接近从头重训参考。
hf.reason: 保持约束融入参数化，方法新颖，覆盖推理、代码与遗忘

hf.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
hf.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce HINT-WAM, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/.
hf.titleZh: HINT-WAM：面向世界动作模型的后见信息训练
hf.summaryZh: 世界动作模型（WAM）把动作生成与未来视觉动态预测耦合，但后训练阶段难以稳定执行任务：离线监督微调只用示范动作训练 flow-matching 动作专家，该专家从未见过自身采样器产生的中间状态；on-policy RL 则受稀疏任务奖励限制，稠密奖励塑形也只提供标量评价，而不是动作目标。HINT-WAM 是首个 on-policy 自蒸馏框架：学生在自身去噪轨迹的状态上生成动作；同一模型以示范的未来视频作为后见（hindsight）特权信息充当教师，输出条件动作分布作为稠密监督，部署时仅用常规输入，无需环境奖励或仿真交互。为适配 flow-matching 动作专家，HINT-WAM 用 energy score 这一分布级目标，从学生自身样本匹配教师动作分布，而不是回归速度场。
hf.reason: WAM/VLA 后训练新范式，自蒸馏机制清晰扎实

hf.title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
hf.abstract: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA). This reduction prioritizes input variance but may overlook information relevant to predicting the target. We introduce LightTAR, a simple, inexpensive method that adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task. LightTAR augments the standard PCA representation with a few target-aware features extracted jointly from the final and an intermediate encoder layer using regularized partial least squares (PLS). We evaluate LightTAR with 21 tabular models, including tree ensembles, neural networks, and tabular foundation models. LightTAR improves average predictive performance for all models and, averaged across models, improves prediction on almost every MulTaBench dataset. These gains come with a small increase in total runtime relative to PCA representations. LightTAR integrates directly into existing encoding pipelines, improving tabular learners' predictive performance without modifying the encoder or the learner.
hf.titleZh: LightTAR：面向多模态表格学习的轻量快速目标感知表示
hf.summaryZh: 多模态表格学习通常用预训练编码器把文本、图像等非结构化字段编码成嵌入，再用PCA降维，但PCA只保留输入方差最大的方向，可能丢掉与预测目标相关的信息。LightTAR在标准PCA表示之外，用正则化偏最小二乘（PLS）从编码器最后一层和中间层联合抽取少量目标感知特征，直接拼入现有编码管线，无需改动编码器或下游学习器。在21种表格模型（树集成、神经网络、表格基础模型）和MulTaBench数据集上，该方法提升了所有模型的平均预测性能，且总运行时间相对PCA仅有小幅增加。
hf.reason: 多模态表格表示学习，与LLM后训练/Agent主线关联弱

hf.title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
hf.abstract: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. The graph supports joint saving and restoration of rules and world states, while dynamic object binding grounds rule-specified entities in visual instances and uses stored states to constrain generation from their first appearance. We further introduce object attribute state replacement and counterfactual reconstruction training, enabling accurate attribute control and compatible appearance and motion changes while limiting interference with unrelated content. We develop an automated data collection and annotation pipeline using GTA-V and Habitat to construct RuleVerse, a dataset of rule-driven interactions with detailed state and event annotations, including cases where rules take effect before affected objects become visible. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRuler in preserving rule-state consistency across saving and loading and accurately realizing rule outcomes on designated objects and attributes.
hf.titleZh: WorldRuler：可配置规则下的交互式世界建模
hf.summaryZh: 面向可定制玩法的生成式世界模型，需在用户自定义规则下生成场景变化，但存在规则与状态跨存档持久化、以及规则到视觉的落地两大难点。WorldRuler 将规则定义、依赖关系与物体状态组织为可执行的 3D 规则图，把规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈连成闭环，并用动态对象绑定将规则指定实体对应到视觉实例、以存储状态约束其首次出现;配合物体属性状态替换与反事实重建训练实现属性精确控制并抑制无关区域变化。作者用 GTA-V 与 Habitat 搭建自动采集标注管线，构建带状态与事件标注的 RuleVerse 数据集，实验中在存档读档后的规则—状态一致性与指定对象属性变化的准确实现上均表现有效。
hf.reason: 视频生成式世界模型，属视觉生成方向，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线无交集

hf.title: Code World Model 2.0: Towards Infinite Controllable Video Generation
hf.abstract: Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry depending on the interaction, and streaming inference must operate in a few causal steps without accumulating drift across self-generated history. We present Invoker-Render, pairing a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model under a shared conditioning interface over structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language. Trained on an aligned approximately 200-hour multi-granularity corpus, Invoker-Render honors fine geometric constraints when supplied while synthesizing plausible local motion under coarse proxies, enabling runtime selection of input detail. To bridge bidirectional creation and real-time streaming without compounding step compression and rollout drift, we introduce Progressive Forcing (ProForcing). ProForcing first trains a causal predictor and distills it into a four-step renderer using histories derived from training videos. Training then shifts to continuous self-generated rollouts. A pipelined serving stack supports efficient streaming inference. Experiments show versatile control across proxy families, granularities, and camera paths, consistent gains over recent streaming baselines, and stable 30-minute racing rollouts that preserve scene and subject appearance.
hf.titleZh: Code World Model 2.0:迈向无限可控的视频生成
hf.summaryZh: 视觉代理把显式世界状态模拟与照片级视频合成解耦，为离线片段创作与实时交互流式渲染提供可控接口。Invoker-Render 由双向创作模型与因果四步流式模型组成，二者共享同一条件接口，该接口接收结构代理、外观参考与语言;模型在约 200 小时对齐的多粒度语料上训练，在给定精细几何约束时能够遵守约束，在粗粒度代理下也能合成合理的局部运动。为衔接双向创作与实时流式推理，ProForcing 先把因果预测器蒸馏为四步渲染器，再切换到连续自生成 rollout 训练，并配合流水线服务栈。实验显示该方法在代理类型、粒度与相机路径上均具备通用控制能力，稳定优于近期流式基线，并支持 30 分钟赛车场景长程推演而不丢失场景与主体外观。
hf.reason: 可控视频生成与世界模型渲染，属视觉生成低分方向

hf.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
hf.abstract: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across videos generated by open models from 140 start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to 7.3 times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.
hf.titleZh: StrideWorld：评测交互式视频世界模型中场景刚性与动作一致性的基准
hf.summaryZh: 交互式视频世界模型把用户指令转化为对生成场景的探索，因此要求相机移动时场景保持三维结构，并且每个动作保持稳定效果。现有基准的参照系多拟合自被测视频本身（自重建场景或带自由尺度的指令对齐轨迹），会吸收渐进形变与节奏、路线长度的偏差。StrideWorld把参照系固定在运动发生之前：以起始视角的真值几何衡量场景刚性，以每条指令对应相机运动的「步幅」衡量动作一致性，步幅由模型最初几步测得、再用于检验后续步骤。在已知相机运动的渲染视频上验证，其评分与人类判断一致；140个起始视角下除一个模型外全部出现形变，偏移最高达刚性渲染的7.3倍，组合路线中多个模型频繁停滞。
hf.reason: 视频世界模型评测基准，属视觉生成侧，仅与评测方法学擦边

hf.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
hf.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
hf.titleZh: 快速思考，无处不在：为任意 Agent 工作流的决策点提供统一的 System-1
hf.summaryZh: 双系统 Agent 每步都调用大模型带来成本与延迟，而现有 System-1 方案依赖按环境手写的 workflow 挂钩。AnyS1 将人类编写的流程化技能视为决策点与候选项的自然来源，离线从 1000 多个公开技能中挖掘可枚举决策，在隔离容器内采集执行轨迹状态构建 Any-DP 数据集，并训练单个经校准的 4B pointer System-1；运行时编译后的工作流一次前向即可解决常规决策，置信度低于校准阈值时回退 System-2。在三个未见 benchmark 与不同 System-2 模型族上，任务可靠性保持不降，单 episode 成本降低 75–91%、模型调用时间减少 63–92%，且支持零样本阈值迁移。
hf.reason: Agent 双层系统与推理加速，系统性扎实，直接命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
hf.abstract: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1times less data and >120times fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.
hf.titleZh: LogT：用图像进行逻辑思考以完成视觉搜索
hf.summaryZh: 针对 VLM 借助外部 Zoom-in 工具做细粒度视觉搜索时难以兼顾逻辑推理与工具使用准确性的问题，将瓶颈定位在 SFT 数据质量而非 RL 复杂度上，提出全自动 SFT 数据引擎 LogT，显式生成由逻辑链引导、视觉定位扎实的问题与结构化工具调用轨迹。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 InternVL3.5-8B 上微调并于七个 benchmark 评测，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 版本以少 3.1 倍数据、少 120 倍以上 GPU 时数超过 SFT+RL 的 SOTA，叠加无工具专用设计的简单 RL 后进一步领先复杂 RL 方案 9.59 分，同时工具调用更准更省、推理轨迹更具结构性与逻辑一致性。适用于多模态推理与工具使用型 Agent 的数据构建与后训练。
hf.reason: VLM 工具调用与推理数据引擎，命中多模态理解与后训练方向

hf.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
hf.abstract: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
hf.titleZh: Piccolo:通过递归自我改进协同进化决策模型与数据
hf.summaryZh: 面向通用文本与视觉判断、Agent harness、数据工作流与交互游戏的决策模型族(0.8B–27B)，用Agentic Data Engineering与递归自我改进(RSI)让模型能力与训练数据共同进化:研究型Agent分析模型行为、构造训练数据、跑实验并把结果反馈进下一轮提案，语义切片与共享研究记忆串联整个模型族的开发。Piccolo-27B以75.59分登顶Decision Index Vision Full榜首，9B与4B分别为68.35与67.46，三个尺寸均在Private benchmark各自量级类别排名第一。大规模RSI实验给出三条反直觉结论:骨干与配方的协同适配胜过模型新旧、定向数据筛选可让4B–9B在专门工作流上比肩27B基线、连续loss下降会与离散决策准确率脱钩甚至反向。权重与Data-Juicer、AgentScope工具一并开源，构成可复用的决策模型构建蓝图。
hf.reason: 决策模型与数据协同进化的RSI技术报告，直击后训练与自我改进

hf.title: Decoding Without a Decoder: Direct Pixel Prediction from Diffusion Transformers
hf.abstract: Latent diffusion models rely on a decoder to map denoised latents to pixels, adding complexity and inference cost. We introduce Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD), which lets a finetuned diffusion transformer produce final pixels directly through a linear head. Unlike previous methods, where the denoising output leads to final pixels, DWD separates the two roles: the original denoising head continues to drive sampling, then the new DWD head predicts the pixels at the final step. We extend pretrained latent models with DWD efficiently by finetuning only the last few transformer blocks, training the DWD head with pixel quality losses while anchoring the denoising head to the pretrained model to preserve the sample trajectory. Across latent image and video generators, DWD removes the decoder and reduces inference cost while maintaining or even improving pixel quality. On Wan video generation, it visibly reduces detail distortion and flickering, lowering warping error by 23%. Remarkably, the same separation also improves pixel diffusion models that do not even use a decoder: a final-step DWD head produces substantially better texture detail in text-to-image generation, and improves ImageNet FID from 1.55 to 1.43, a new state of the art among pixel flow models.
hf.titleZh: 无需解码器即可解码:从扩散 Transformer 直接预测像素
hf.summaryZh: 潜空间扩散模型依赖解码器把去噪后的潜变量还原为像素，既增加系统复杂度又带来额外推理开销。DWD 把去噪与像素还原两个角色拆开:原去噪头继续驱动采样轨迹，新增的线性 DWD 头只在最后一步预测像素，并且仅微调最后几个 Transformer 块，以像素质量损失训练 DWD 头，同时把去噪头锚定到预训练模型。在潜空间图像与视频生成器上，该方法去掉解码器并降低推理成本，像素质量保持甚至提升;在 Wan 视频生成上扭曲误差降低 23%，细节失真与闪烁明显减少;对本身无解码器的像素扩散模型，ImageNet FID 从 1.55 降至 1.43。
hf.reason: 扩散图像/视频生成，属画像明确的低分方向

hf.title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
hf.abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.
hf.titleZh: TabBioMed:面向生物医学表格学习的大规模基准
hf.summaryZh: 生物医学结构化数据的模型评测长期碎片化，高维、大样本、缺失值与类别不平衡场景下缺乏可复现的统一比较。TabBioMed 汇集 94 个公开生物医学表格数据集，覆盖电子病历、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学与系统生物学，并以数据集感知的标准化预处理与评测框架统一分类、回归与多目标任务。基准评测了 23 个模型，涵盖经典基线、梯度提升树、神经表格架构与表格基础模型:基础模型在家族层面整体最强，但优势依赖数据情形，树模型与调优 MLP 在推理时延或训练成本受限时常占优。工作表明最优模型取决于数据情形、任务类型与算力预算，适用于生物医学场景下的模型选型与方法开发。
hf.reason: 生物医学表格数据基准，属生医信息学，与 LLM 主线仅边缘相关

hf.title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
hf.abstract: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.
hf.titleZh: QDA：Agent 驱动的闭环 LLM 量化设计
hf.summaryZh: 针对不同模型与精度需人工重设计量化配方的问题，QDA让LLM Agent闭环地构建并评估候选方案：用未见推理轨迹上的输出KL散度在数分钟内为候选打分，再用长生成检查重复循环等失效，并提供互相兼容、适配新架构的公开PTQ方法库。在四个推理模型上，W4A16、W4A8、W3A16的平均准确率分别超过最强公开配方0.9、1.4、2.2个百分点，单次搜索耗64 GPU小时；在320B参数MoE模型GLM-5.3-Flash的NVFP4 W4A4上恢复FP8精度的98.3%，厂商最佳checkpoint为96.9%，且量化产物可直接运行现有serving kernel、无推理开销。
hf.reason: Agent闭环设计量化配方，效率与系统性强，结果扎实

hf.title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
hf.abstract: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.
hf.titleZh: BLIP-Live：在主动式流式视频Agent中平衡及时性与触发精确率
hf.summaryZh: 针对流式视频理解中「何时该响应」的主动性问题：系统需要在证据充分时尽快响应，同时避免过早、冗余或错误触发。工作构建了BLIP-Live-780K数据集，其中包含人工标注的响应内容与响应时机；提出PAUC-F指标，把响应及时性与触发精确率结合起来，既奖励早期有用响应，又不奖励过度触发。在此基础上，系统比较了滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆、结构化输出等与模型无关的推理harness及相应训练流程。BLIP-Live-Qwen在四个主动流式视频基准上达到SOTA，相对基线最高提升44%，并超过多个闭源API模型。
hf.reason: VLM流式视频主动响应，数据集、新指标与harness齐备，系统性强

hf.title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
hf.abstract: Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). For such software, a key testing bottleneck is reaching a deep state, one that requires a long interaction history. The cost of reaching it recurs across commits, and the GUI automation that could amortize it assumes a DOM or accessibility tree that self-rendered engines do not expose. We introduce StatePortal, an agent that synthesizes a checkpoint, an artifact that restores that state and can be versioned and replayed, from a natural-language functional test case and read-only access to the target's source code. The checkpoint is restored through a per-application hook that an onboarding agent binds or synthesizes once without hand-written hook code. Because a checkpoint can satisfy state checks while rendering incorrectly, checkpoints are scored by hybrid programmatic-state and visual evaluation: acceptance requires both a programmatic-state oracle and a visual oracle to pass. We calibrate the visual oracle against a blinded cross-VLM reference. We release DeepStateBench, 61 deep-state tasks across 10 interactive applications that span five language families and six rendering stacks, with source sizes from 874 to 7.2M lines. Across three registered models, a GUI agent seeded with synthesized checkpoints completes 10.4% of trials, compared with 0% without seeding under the same pixel action space, while StatePortal, which also delivers the target action through the hook, completes 27.5%. Over 1,361 replays of 112 checkpoints, 98.90% reproduce the original verdict with zero model calls, and the hybrid oracle detects 96.25% (77/80) of controlled visual faults invisible to programmatic-state checks alone. We open-source our code at https://github.com/pzy2000/State_Portal and website at https://stateportal.mineyosemite.chatgpt.site
hf.titleZh: StatePortal:面向交互式软件深状态测试的 Agent 化检查点合成
hf.summaryZh: GUI 交互软件的深层状态需要长交互历史才能到达，测试成本在每个 commit 上重复付出，而自渲染引擎又不暴露 DOM 或可访问性树。StatePortal 依据自然语言功能测试用例与只读源码合成可版本化、可重放的 checkpoint，并通过 onboarding agent 一次性绑定或合成按应用恢复的 hook。验收采用程序状态与视觉双 oracle，视觉 oracle 以跨 VLM 盲评校准;同时发布覆盖 10 个应用、5 个语言族与 6 种渲染栈的 DeepStateBench。用合成 checkpoint 播种后 GUI agent 完成率 10.4%(未播种 0%),StatePortal 达 27.5%;1,361 次重放中 98.90% 零模型调用复现原判定。
hf.reason: GUI 测试智能体与基准发布，属 Agent 应用但偏软件测试细分

hf.title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
hf.abstract: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues. Both add inference overhead, and the generated layout often drifts from the ground truth. We present WaveView, which injects the warped source into the phase of the initial noise of a pretrained generator. The Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform (DT-CWPT) allows local and anisotropic phase injection. The generator is thus constrained less in disoccluded regions and along the epipolar line. WaveView keeps the architecture and adds negligible overhead. On the DL3DV benchmark, it outperforms all baselines in every overlap bin. In the hardest bin, it gains 0.84 dB PSNR on the covisible region over MetaView, which shares its generator, while running 2.1 times faster. For dynamic NVS, fine-tuning AnyView with the same noise raises its zero-shot PSNR on AnyViewBench from 11.58 to 12.35 dB.
hf.titleZh: WaveView：新颖视角藏于噪声之中
hf.summaryZh: 生成式新视角合成（NVS）需要扩散模型从目标相机视角渲染静态或动态场景，显式 warp 与隐式编码方法都带来额外推理开销，且生成布局容易偏离真值。WaveView 将 warp 后的源图像注入预训练生成器初始噪声的相位中，借助双树复小波包变换（DT-CWPT）实现局部、各向异性的相位注入，使生成器在遮挡解除区域和极线方向上的约束更宽松，同时保持原架构、几乎不增加开销。在 DL3DV 上，它在所有重叠区间都优于基线；最难的区间里，共视区域 PSNR 比共享同一生成器的 MetaView 高 0.84 dB，速度快 2.1 倍。把同一噪声注入用于 AnyView 微调，可将其在 AnyViewBench 上的零样本 PSNR 从 11.58 dB 提升到 12.35 dB。
hf.reason: 扩散式新视角合成，落在视觉生成低分方向

hf.title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
hf.abstract: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user. When the observed scene contains a physical hazard, personal context, such as allergies, medical conditions, or mobility constraints, can change what help is appropriate. Responding appropriately therefore requires recognizing the visible hazard and applying the relevant person's information. We introduce PReMind-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates this combination across diverse hazards and personal-memory conditions. It separately measures memory access, grounding, abstention, and hazard response, and assesses joint success on interdependency cases. Existing models often satisfy one requirement while failing the other, and training only for safety or personalization leaves a gap in joint success. We therefore propose PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that combines on-demand and forced-call interactions (memory always retrieved) to jointly train grounded memory use and hazard response. At 4B, PReMind raises joint success from 12.9% to 28.6% over its base on the interdependency set and improves hazard adequacy and correct abstention on the main test. Joint-success gains persist under forced-call evaluation and under a second LLM judge across three Phase II seeds; averaged over these seeds, joint success also improves on unseen hazard groups. These findings highlight the need to evaluate and train personal assistants to connect visual evidence with the relevant person's context.
hf.titleZh: PReMind：当个人记忆遇上视觉危险
hf.summaryZh: 个性化视觉语言助手需结合场景观察与个人记忆(过敏、病史、行动限制)才能给出恰当建议，而现有模型往往只满足其中一项。工作提出 PReMind-Bench 诊断基准，分别测量记忆访问、视觉 grounding、正确弃答与危险应对，并考察二者的联合成功;同时给出 PReMind 两阶段强化学习框架，混合按需调用与强制调用(始终检索记忆)两类交互，联合训练 grounded 记忆使用与危险响应。4B 模型在 interdependency 子集上把联合成功率从 12.9% 提升到 28.6%，主测试集上危险应对充分性与正确弃答同步改善，增益在强制调用评估、第二个 LLM judge 与三个随机种子下保持，并泛化到未见危险类别。
hf.reason: 多模态个性化助手的 RL 训练与配套诊断基准，命中后训练与多模态理解

hf.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
hf.abstract: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. We study the opposite strategy, late entry, where new tokens skip initial passes and enter directly into the final K < T passes over a deep context cache. Once lightweight fine-tuning resolves hidden-state norm mismatch at the entry boundary, deep cached context substitutes for skipped token-local passes, allowing late entry to outperform matched early exit across model families and pass budgets. To turn this asymmetry into wall-clock speedups without stalling to build deep caches, candidate blocks verify through only the final K passes on the critical path while previously committed tokens complete passes 1 -> T alongside subsequent steps at zero extra serial calls. Projecting these finished T-pass wake states inside the existing output GEMM (Wake verification, governed by logit-margin tolerance tau in [0, inf]) unifies greedy-exact T-pass decoding (tau = 0, matching K = T block decoding within bf16 reduction order), margin-gated verification (tau > 0), and non-rollback lossy late entry (tau = inf) inside a single static CUDA graph. On Ouro-2.6B (T = 4), K = 2 Wake reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup at tau = 0 (+26% over K = 4 block decoding on GSM8K) and 6.8x at tau = inf (+16.9 points over trained early exit at matched speed). Scaling test-time recurrence across T in {8, 16, 32, 64} on Huginn-3.5B cuts K = T/4 rollbacks 21.5x with depth, driving greedy-exact (tau = 0) speedups to 6.1x (T = 32) and 8.4x (T = 64, +153% over K = 64 block) and tau = inf speedups to 10.6 to 12.5x.
hf.titleZh: 循环语言模型中的晚进入
hf.summaryZh: 循环语言模型靠重复共享层堆栈加深推理，但每个token跑满T次前向使解码延迟随深度增长。late entry让新token跳过前若干次pass，直接进入深上下文缓存的最后K次pass，并用轻量微调消除入口隐状态范数不匹配；推理时用Wake验证在输出GEMM内投影已完成T-pass的状态，将精确贪心解码、margin门控验证与有损late entry统一进单个静态CUDA图。Ouro-2.6B（T=4、K=2）取得5.2×贪心精确加速，τ=∞时6.8×且比同速trained early exit高16.9分；Huginn-3.5B在T=64时贪心精确加速达8.4×，τ=∞达12.5×。
hf.reason: 循环模型推理加速，late entry机制新颖，实验扎实

hf.title: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
hf.abstract: Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video cases, covering highlight detection and selection, source-video ordering, and adherence to user requirements when provided; and (2) a speech-driven setting over automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, covering filler removal, expression deduplication, and low-value content trimming. Across these settings, the benchmark contains 101 visually driven cases, including 831 raw videos with 1,476 highlight annotations. It also includes 84 speech-driven cases, each consisting of an ASR transcript with annotated cleanup spans. The evaluation compares cut plans with these annotations in both settings and additionally uses a human-aligned agentic evaluator to assess rendered-cut quality in the visual setting. To apply LVLMs to automatic rough-cut, we further propose agentic workflows that guide them to produce structured cut plans from input materials. Experiments show that current LVLMs remain limited in producing expert-aligned cut plans. Our benchmark, code, and prompts are released at https://whalesong-zrs.github.io/RoughCut-Bench-Project-Page.
hf.titleZh: RoughCut-Bench：基于大型视觉语言模型的自动视频粗剪基准
hf.summaryZh: 视频粗剪是媒体生产中的核心环节，但大型视觉语言模型在该任务上的能力缺乏统一评测。RoughCut-Bench 设置两类场景：视觉驱动场景覆盖高光检测与选取、素材排序及用户需求遵循，含 101 个案例、831 段原始视频与 1476 条高光标注；语音驱动场景基于 ASR 转写文本，覆盖口头语去除、重复表达合并与低价值内容裁剪，含 84 个案例。配套提出 agentic 工作流，引导模型输出结构化剪辑方案，评测结合标注比对与人类对齐的智能体评估器。结果显示现有 LVLM 生成的剪辑方案仍难以达到专家水平，为该方向的评测与工作流设计提供了基线。
hf.reason: LVLM 视频理解评测基准，方向擦边、分量中等

hf.title: Mechanistic Critics for Sample-Efficient NPU Design-Space Exploration
hf.abstract: NPU design-space exploration for LLM inference mainly relies on an expensive simulator that often returns only scalar feedback such as latency and power. Such feedback can rank evaluated configurations, but gives little information for deciding why a configuration is slow or which architecture parameter should be changed next. This limitation is especially severe because prefill and decode workloads can be limited by different resources, including compute throughput and HBM bandwidth. We propose CriticNPU, a sample-efficient DSE framework built around an online-calibrated mechanistic critic for NPU architecture design. The critic uses explicit hardware limits to evaluate NPU configurations: before simulation, it estimates whether a proposed configuration is likely to improve over the current best and filters weak candidates; after simulation, it aggregates operator-level runtimes into prefill/decode bottleneck summaries and predicts the effect of candidate parameter changes. We instantiate the critic with a Roofline-style model that derives compute and memory limits from architecture parameters and calibrates per-operator-type effective limits using simulator observations. And CriticNPU combines this critic with a workload extractor and an architecture planner to propose configurations. Across six LLM workloads and 16 deployment configurations per model, CriticNPU achieves best-or-tied-best latency in 74% of prefill and 87.5% of decode settings while using roughly half the simulator calls of competitive DSE baselines. We conduct extensive ablation studies and detailed analyses to validate the effectiveness of our method from multiple perspectives. Our code is available at https://github.com/bruno686/CriticNPU.
hf.titleZh: 用于样本高效NPU设计空间探索的机制性critic
hf.summaryZh: LLM推理的NPU设计空间探索依赖昂贵的模拟器，而模拟器往往只返回延迟、功耗等标量反馈，既无法解释某配置为何慢，也难以判断下一步该改哪个架构参数；同时prefill与decode可能分别受算力吞吐与HBM带宽限制。CriticNPU围绕一个在线校准的机制性critic构建：模拟前用显式硬件上限估计候选配置能否超越当前最优并过滤弱候选，模拟后把算子级运行时间聚合为prefill/decode瓶颈摘要，并预测候选参数改动的影响；critic采用Roofline式模型从架构参数推导算力与内存上限，并用模拟器观测校准分算子类型的有效上限，再与workload提取器、架构规划器配合提出配置。在6个LLM负载、每个模型16种部署配置下，74%的prefill与87.5%的decode设置取得最优或并列最优延迟，模拟器调用次数约为竞争性DSE基线的一半。
hf.reason: NPU架构设计空间探索偏硬件，仅与LLM推理效率方向擦边

hf.title: Unfinished-Bench: Measuring Rule Violations by Persistent Agents in Realistic Work Environments
hf.abstract: AI agents are increasingly equipped with persistence toward task completion to run delegated work autonomously for long periods, under many unstated constraints from internal documents and other people's authority. When completion requires violating a rule, the agent must decide alone, yet benchmarks of instruction-rule conflicts state the rule in the prompt or keep it hidden and do not evaluate persistence. We present Unfinished-Bench, a benchmark that gives models persistence in autonomous runs without a user, in realistic work environments with embedded rules. In each of its 97 scenarios across 7 organizations and 7 risk categories, the goal and the rule cannot both hold. We find that persistence raised violations of a rule in an internal document from 32.2% to 43.6%, five times the 8.5% for the same rule stated by the user. Of the document-rule violations, 98.3% occurred after the rule was displayed, and in 89% of a judged sample the agent first wrote down the rule. Violations of rules placed in the environment without user oversight can lead to serious incidents, so persistence-driven risks need to be evaluated. Benchmark documentation: https://francis21c.github.io/unfinished-bench/
hf.titleZh: Unfinished-Bench：测量持久型 Agent 在真实工作环境中的规则违反行为
hf.summaryZh: 现有指令—规则冲突基准要么在 prompt 中明示规则，要么完全隐藏规则，且都不考察 Agent 的持久自主性。Unfinished-Bench 构建了覆盖 7 个组织、7 类风险的 97 个场景，每个场景中任务目标与嵌入环境的规则不可兼得，模型需在无用户监督下自主长时运行。结果显示，持久性使内部文档规则的违反率从 32.2% 升至 43.6%，是同一规则由用户明示时 8.5% 的五倍;98.3% 的文档规则违反发生在规则已被展示之后，在人工判定的样本中有 89% 的 Agent 先写下了规则。该基准表明环境内嵌规则在持久自主运行下的失效风险，适用于 Agent 安全与对齐评测。
hf.reason: Agent 规则遵守评测基准，命中 Agent 与评测方法学方向

hf.title: How Far Can Untrained Neural Networks Go in Anomaly Detection? From Tables to Pixels
hf.abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is often framed as a representation-learning problem, where strong performance is expected to require learned features or AD-specific optimization. However, this view can overlook the intrinsic separability of anomalies from normal references, even in the absence of learned representations. We therefore investigate how far untrained neural networks can go in anomaly detection. To this end, we propose PRISM, a framework combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring for tabular detection and dense visual localization. Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods. On MVTec AD and VisA, covering 27 visual categories, PRISM-V achieves mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively. Notably, both models achieve these results without neural weight optimization or pretrained representations. A theoretical analysis further characterizes how nonlinear transformations affect the mean and covariance contributions to the Mahalanobis score gap, while empirical analyses examine the resulting score separability. These findings establish PRISM as both a competitive anomaly detector and a prior-to-learning baseline for assessing the added value of learned representations in anomaly detection.
hf.titleZh: 未训练的神经网络在异常检测中能走多远？从表格到像素
hf.summaryZh: 质疑异常检测必须依赖表征学习或专门优化的既有观点，转而检验固定随机非线性特征的内在可分性。提出 PRISM 框架：用固定随机非线性特征配合正常参考的 Mahalanobis 打分，同时覆盖表格检测与稠密视觉定位。在 ADBench 的 47 个表格数据集上，PRISM-T 取得最高平均 AUROC 86.4% 与第二高平均 AUPRC 65.9%；在 MVTec AD 与 VisA 共 27 个视觉类别上，PRISM-V 的图像级与像素级平均 AUROC 分别为 90.4% 和 96.4%，全程无神经权重优化、无预训练表征。理论分析刻画了非线性变换如何影响均值与协方差对 Mahalanobis 分数间隔的贡献，为衡量学习表征带来的真实增益提供了「学习前」基线。
hf.reason: 随机特征加 Mahalanobis 的异常检测，与 LLM 后训练／Agent 方向无关

hf.title: PIPETTE: Prompt Injection Purple-Teaming for Robust LLM Agents
hf.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks. To uncover these vulnerabilities at scale, automated red-teaming methods often leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to generate attacks that achieve high attack success rates (ASR). Model developers use the attacks discovered during internal red-teaming to harden agents through adversarial training before deployment, a collaborative offensive-defensive process known in cybersecurity as purple-teaming. However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training. Specifically, we find that two state-of-the-art RL-based red-teaming methods, RL-Hammer and PISmith, suffer from mode collapse, repeatedly discovering similar attack strategies whose additional successes add no additional robustness improvements to adversarial training. To address this gap, we introduce PIPETTE, a unified prompt injection purple-teaming framework that effectively converts red-teaming discoveries into defender robustness improvements. PIPETTE employs a dictionary learning-based reward that encourages broader coverage of attack strategies during red-teaming. It also integrates an on-policy adversarial training pipeline tailored to IPI defense, enabling agents to resist attacks while completing legitimate user tasks. Extensive evaluations across agentic benchmarks (AgentDojo and ASB) demonstrate that PIPETTE produces defenders that achieve near-zero attack success rates on static attacks and can withstand strong adaptive attacks, while maintaining benign task utility close to that of the undefended baseline.
hf.titleZh: PIPETTE：面向鲁棒 LLM Agent 的提示注入紫队测试
hf.summaryZh: 自动红队方法常用 RL 生成间接提示注入攻击，但高攻击成功率未必能转化为对抗训练后的鲁棒性提升：RL-Hammer 与 PISmith 都出现模式坍缩，反复发现相似攻击策略，额外成功样本对防御训练几乎无增益。PIPETTE 统一紫队框架用基于字典学习的奖励鼓励覆盖更多攻击策略，并配套面向 IPI 防御的 on-policy 对抗训练流程，使 Agent 在完成合法用户任务的同时抵御攻击。在 AgentDojo 与 ASB 上，防御方对静态攻击的攻击成功率接近零，能承受强自适应攻击，良性任务效用接近无防御基线。
hf.reason: 红队与对抗训练闭环改进 Agent 安全，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

hf.title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. Rather than scoring the full dialogue prefix, ECA queries a frozen snapshot of the current policy under an evidence-only prompt containing solely the question and the deduplicated documents observed so far, isolating the utility of retrieved passages from surface variations in generated thoughts or search queries. Within this framework, we compare two return formulations, ECA-Step (which accumulates step-clipped potential increments) and ECA-Horizon (which preserves the telescoping horizon gain in potential), paired with cross-fold group normalization, novelty gating, and search-local token assignment. Across seven Search QA benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves strict macro exact match over an outcome-only GRPO baseline by 1.03 and 4.80 percentage points on Qwen2.5-3B- and 7B-Instruct, respectively, outperforming both RLOO and GiGPO. Zero-shot evaluation on MultiHop-RAG further demonstrates strong transfer to multi-hop inference queries.
hf.titleZh: 面向搜索增强语言模型的基于证据的信用分配
hf.summaryZh: 结果监督的搜索增强 RL 给轨迹中每次检索相同信用，无论是否取回有用信息；当组内所有 rollout 全部失败时，组中心化优势更是塌缩为零。ECA 引入训练期辅助信号，用冻结的当前策略快照在仅含问题与已见去重文档的 evidence-only prompt 下打分，把检索段落的效用与生成思维、查询的表面差异隔离开，并比较 ECA-Step（步级截断潜力增量）与 ECA-Horizon（保留望远镜式 horizon 增益）两种回报，辅以 cross-fold group normalization、novelty gating 与 search-local token assignment。七个 Search QA 基准上，ECA-Horizon 的 strict macro exact match 相比 outcome-only GRPO 在 Qwen2.5-3B 与 7B-Instruct 上分别提升 1.03 与 4.80 个百分点，优于 RLOO 与 GiGPO；在 MultiHop-RAG 的零样本评测中亦表现出向多跳推理的良好迁移。
hf.reason: 搜索增强 RL 的信用分配改进，命中后训练方向且方法可拆解

hf.title: VAE Rhythm: Temporal Decoding Traces for AI-Generated Video Detection
hf.abstract: Visible artifacts are an unreliable cue for detecting generated videos, because newer generators learn to remove them. We instead detect a trace left by the generation pipeline itself. Most video generators decode latents with a 3D causal VAE that groups consecutive frames in time, so the fidelity of generated frames rises and falls periodically with their position in a group. We call this periodic trace VAE Rhythm. Real videos are captured frame by frame and do not have it. To reveal it without training, we propose a phase scan. The scan reconstructs a clip with an off-the-shelf VAE from successive start offsets and measures the periodicity of the reconstruction error across these offsets. We find VAE Rhythm in most of the 39 variants of 31 generators we test, including the closed-source Sora, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0. We use the rhythm as a zero-shot score, as a plug-in for existing detectors and as a data engine that pairs real videos with their VAE reconstructions to train our detector CaDet. On DF26, the training-free rhythm score outperforms all 15 retrained baselines, and as a plug-in it improves all 19 tested detectors by 6.7% to 23.7% AUROC. CaDet achieves the best AUROC on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and its variant trained without any generated video still exceeds 90% on AIGVDBench.
hf.titleZh: VAE Rhythm：AI生成视频检测的时间解码痕迹
hf.summaryZh: 可见伪影会随生成器升级而失效，检测转而利用生成管线自身的痕迹：多数视频生成器用3D因果VAE按时间分组解码帧，组内位置使生成帧保真度周期性起伏，即VAE Rhythm，而逐帧拍摄的真实视频不具备该性质。相位扫描无需训练：用现成VAE从不同起始偏移重建片段，度量重建误差随偏移的周期性，即可在31个生成器的39个变体中多数检出，含Sora与Kling 3.0。该节奏可作零样本打分，作即插件使19个检测器AUROC提升6.7%–23.7%，并用于训练检测器CaDet；后者在DF26、AIGVDBench与三个2026闭源模型上AUROC最佳，无生成视频训练的变体仍超90%。
hf.reason: 视频生成取证与检测，属视觉生成低分方向，与LLM无关

arxiv.title: Beam Model Technical Report
arxiv.abstract: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.
arxiv.titleZh: Beam 模型技术报告
arxiv.summaryZh: Beam 是一个总参数 501.3B、激活参数 23.4B 的稀疏 MoE 模型，面向代码、推理与 Agent 负载而构建，推理算力需求比同类模型低 3–4 倍。预训练使用 23.8T 精选 token，并通过以可验证、正确性为锚定数据的两阶段 midtraining 获得 1M token 上下文。后训练在 10.5K 张 GB300 上开展大规模全异步 RL，4 周生成超 1 亿条 rollout，评测显示能力随 RL 算力持续提升且未见平台期。配合 FP8/NVFP4 量化与 1.93B 投机解码草稿模型 DFlash 2 优化部署吞吐。
arxiv.reason: 旗舰级 MoE 技术报告，覆盖大规模异步 RL 与 Agent 能力，直接命中

arxiv.title: How Language Models Compress and Compare: Understanding Selection with Token Covariance Maps
arxiv.abstract: Many language-model tasks reduce to selecting among structured alternatives, yet we still lack a simple picture of how a decoder-only transformer organizes an entire selection prompt across depth. We introduce token covariance maps, a prompt-level geometric view that tracks how token positions co-vary in hidden-state space at each layer. This turns a structured prompt into a depth-indexed sequence of maps whose spectral and block structure can be aligned with instructions, context, and candidate answers. Across 14 decoder-only models from 4 families and 12 structured-selection benchmarks, token covariance maps reveal a robust compress-then-compare organization. Early layers represent prompts diffusely, middle layers compress them into a shared low-rank bottleneck, and late layers re-expand into context-option and option-option geometry. This organization recurs across larger fixed-template samples, deterministic prompt rewrites, pairwise reranking reformulations, and controlled answer-set manipulations, while also emerging during training from an initially flat depth profile. Its timing aligns with behavior: useful answer discrimination appears well after the bottleneck, and low-rank intervention around the bottleneck preferentially disrupts late comparison geometry. We additionally show that the same geometric profile appears in instruction-tuned models, across several languages, and during open-ended generation. We further show that changing the internal representation of one candidate around the compressed region can shift which candidate the model later prefers. These results show that token covariance maps are a diagnostic tool for comparing how models organize information across prompts, model families, and stages of training.
arxiv.titleZh: 语言模型如何压缩与比较：用 Token 协方差图理解选择过程
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对结构化选择任务中解码器 Transformer 如何在深度上组织整个提示缺乏统一刻画的问题，提出 token 协方差图：逐层追踪 token 位置在隐状态空间中的协变关系，把提示转化为按深度索引的图谱，并用谱结构与块结构对齐指令、上下文与候选答案。在 4 个模型家族共 14 个解码器模型、12 个结构化选择基准上发现稳定的「先压缩后比较」组织：浅层弥散表示，中层压缩为共享低秩瓶颈，深层重新展开为上下文-选项与选项-选项几何。该组织在确定性改写、成对重排、答案集操控下复现，瓶颈附近做低秩干预会优先破坏后期的比较几何，且改变压缩区某候选的内部表示可改变模型最终偏好，为跨提示、跨模型家族的诊断提供工具。
arxiv.reason: 揭示 LLM 内部压缩-比较机制，方法新颖、实验系统，直击架构与推理分析

arxiv.title: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. Crucially, their advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning of both search-pretrained and conventionally pretrained models, indicating that the tested post-training procedures do not fully recover the capabilities developed during pretraining. Throughout our experiments, we find that a 1.4B QueryLM consistently beats or matches the performance of a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline model across all knowledge intensive tasks. These results establish search-pretraining as a practical way to develop foundational search capabilities during pretraining. We release the training artifacts, including model checkpoints and data.
arxiv.titleZh: 从预训练开始搜索：语言模型的搜索原生预训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对搜索能力通常在后训练才引入、预训练仍以静态文本预测为主的问题，提出搜索原生预训练：在大规模语料中注入网络搜索查询，并用本地索引检索网页响应，使模型在语言建模过程中学会生成搜索调用并利用检索证据。在 Wikipedia 与 DCLM-Edu 语料、360M 至 3.3B 参数规模上训练的 QueryLM 在知识密集型任务上表现更优，且对检索证据的可引导性更强；优势在监督微调后依然保留，说明后训练难以完全补回预训练阶段形成的能力。1.4B QueryLM 在所有知识密集任务上稳定优于或持平 FLOP 对齐的 3.3B 基线，表明搜索预训练是低成本构建基础搜索能力的可行路径。
arxiv.reason: 搜索原生预训练新范式，命中预训练与Agent工具调用

arxiv.title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
arxiv.abstract: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a student model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B student models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
arxiv.titleZh: AutoMaster:让同一模型成为更好的教师以实现自主后训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对仅以任务成功为信号无法区分轨迹中哪些行为值得强化的问题，提出Skill-FT:用自然语言技能描述抑制教师轨迹里的无效重复、无依据假设与浅层验证等不良习惯，再在筛选后的轨迹上微调目标模型。AutoMaster将这一过程交由LLM agent自主完成轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择与基于rollout和评测反馈的迭代。在Terminal、Search与软件工程任务上，用4B与9B目标模型、固定教师与SFT配方，平均性能较朴素SFT提升1.42–8.99个百分点;六个设置中SFT阶段保留技能指令均优于移除，提示技能上下文有助于行为内化。
arxiv.reason: 自主后训练+Agent数据合成，直接命中后训练与Agent方向

arxiv.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa.
arxiv.titleZh: HiSA:在 LLM 的 RoPE 注意力中稀疏化隐藏维度
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对注意力中每个 query 与所有 key 都要做完整点积这一开销，提出隐藏稀疏注意力 HiSA:在保留 query/key 投影完整的前提下，依据 token 位置用静态、无参数的规则只计算部分点积，使稀疏发生在隐藏(特征)维度而非几乎所有稀疏注意力方法采用的 token 维度;基于 RoPE 的结构将 query 与 key 分解为可省略的部分。从头训练 LLM 时，HiSA 只用约三分之一点积计算量，性能不降反升;推理阶段提升解码速度并降低显存占用，并已扩展到 FlashAttention-3 训练与推理 kernel。分析显示稠密注意力本身会学习抑制 HiSA 所丢弃的那部分注意力分数，为该设计提供了动机。
arxiv.reason: LLM 注意力稀疏化新范式，含从零训练与 FlashAttention-3 内核，直击架构与效率

arxiv.title: Budget Internalization: Fixed-Budget RLVR Trades Test-Time Scaling for In-Budget Accuracy
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning models often become more accurate when they can generate longer answers at test time. This behavior is known as test-time scaling. However, RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually trains them with a fixed rollout cap. We find that this cap changes model behavior, not only training cost. After training, models use few additional tokens beyond the training budget. They outperform the base models near that budget, but their accuracy stops improving and falls below the base model at larger budgets. The rollout cap thus becomes a learned constraint, that limits model's test-time scaling. We call this effect budget internalization. We observe it across Qwen3.5-4B, Gemma4-E2B, and Nemotron-3-Nano-4B and two reasoning training tasks: mathematical reasoning and diverse, procedurally generated problems. This effect also transfers from math training to science and coding tasks. Training-objective level ablations on Qwen3.5-4B show that most changes recover little test-time scaling. Stronger KL regularization and lower training-data truncation preserve more scaling, but stronger KL reduces in-budget accuracy. Forcing an answer on truncated training rollouts largely removes budget internalization, but also removes most of the in-budget gain. SFT on artificially truncated traces reproduces budget internalization, whereas SFT on naturally short traces does not, which shows that the effect is not specific to RL. This result links budget internalization to length-censored post-training rather than to an RL-specific objective term. Thus, a rollout cap does not only control training cost. It can trade low-budget gains for lower performance when additional inference compute is available.
arxiv.titleZh: 预算内化:固定预算 RLVR 以测试时扩展换取预算内准确率
arxiv.summaryZh: RLVR 训练通常给 rollout 设固定长度上限，该上限不仅控制成本，还会被模型内化为学到的约束。在 Qwen3.5-4B、Gemma4-E2B、Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 的数学推理与程序化生成任务上，训练后模型在接近预算处优于基座，但更大预算下准确率停滞甚至低于基座，该效应还可迁移到科学与代码任务。目标层消融与 SFT 实验表明，对截断轨迹做 SFT 即可复现该效应，根源是长度截断的后训练而非 RL 特有目标项，更强 KL 虽保留部分扩展能力却降低预算内准确率。这说明 rollout 上限在以低预算增益换取大预算下的性能。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 与测试时扩展的机制性发现，多模型实验扎实

arxiv.title: RL Can Only Reinforce What It Sees Succeed
arxiv.abstract: When a familiar rule stops working, an agent has to weigh what pre-training taught it against what it now observes. We ask how outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL) changes this balance, in a puzzle world where both sides are known: small language models trained from scratch on games played by a Bayesian player, so that the prior and the right answer are exact. Base models hedge as their corpus did, and RL turns that hedging into decisions, in whichever direction the reward favours. But RL can only reinforce what it sees succeed. When the right action is rare, each run either learns it everywhere or not at all, and which runs take off is predicted before training by one count: the expected number of groups of attempts in which the action wins. About 35 such groups give even odds. The count holds for new and repeated problems and for groups of 4 to 256 attempts, and across learning rates, optimizers, GRPO variants and model sizes from 1.3M to 85M parameters, which move the threshold but not what is counted.
arxiv.titleZh: RL只能强化它所见之成功
arxiv.summaryZh: outcome-reward RL如何改变模型在预训练先验与现场观测之间的权衡，此前缺少可精确控制的实验环境。该工作在先验与正确答案均已知的谜题世界中，用贝叶斯玩家对局从头训练小语言模型：基座模型沿用其语料中的对冲行为，RL则按奖励方向把对冲变成决策；但RL只能强化它采样到成功的动作，当正确动作稀有，每次训练要么全面学会要么完全学不会，而是否起飞可在训练前由一个计数预测，即正确动作获胜的尝试组期望数，约35组时胜率为五成。该计数在4–256的组大小、不同学习率与优化器、GRPO变体以及1.3M–85M参数模型上成立，只移动阈值而不改变所计之物，为判断outcome-reward RL能否学到稀有正确行为提供了可检验的预测量。
arxiv.reason: 对GRPO/RLVR可学习性的机制性分析，判据可预测，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Hybrid language models combine self-attention with recurrent layers whose in-place state updates restrict prefix reuse to exact saved positions. Saving states on a coarse grid wastes reusable prefixes, whereas existing fine-grained exact caches must cut the prefill forward pass at each mid-prompt checkpoint, adding scheduler steps that outweigh the reuse gains under load. We observe that across multi-turn chat, agent loops, document question answering, and tree search, prefix reuse almost always ends at structural boundaries predictable in advance, such as turn ends and known branch points. We present FrontierReplay, a prefix caching system that materializes exact checkpoints at these boundaries without cutting the prefill. While the forward pass runs uncut, FrontierReplay logs a short window of recurrent-layer inputs and invokes a cross-layer, state-only replay kernel to build the target state 6-37x cheaper per token than full recomputation without host synchronization. A frontier-aware retention policy prioritizes active anchors and proven branches while lending dead checkpoint slots to the attention KV cache. Across diverse hybrid architectures, model scales, and workloads, FrontierReplay delivers clear gains over existing exact caches, lowering median time to first token (TTFT) by 16-89% (up to 8.9x), raising 80% service-level objective (SLO) capacity by up to 1.73x, and improving goodput by up to 4.26x (3.67x at larger scales). Compared with approximate replay methods, FrontierReplay delivers up to 1.54x higher goodput while preserving exact task accuracy, avoiding the up to 17% accuracy drop suffered by approximation on long contexts.
arxiv.comment: 15 pages (12 pages main text + references), 12 figures, 4 tables
arxiv.titleZh: FrontierReplay:面向混合语言模型的无切分精确前缀缓存
arxiv.summaryZh: 混合语言模型把自注意力与原地更新状态的循环层结合，前缀复用只能停在已保存的精确位置:粗粒度网格浪费可复用前缀，细粒度精确缓存又必须在每个中途检查点切断 prefill，调度开销在高负载下抵消复用收益。FrontierReplay 利用多轮对话、Agent 循环、文档问答与树搜索中前缀复用几乎总终止于可预先预测的结构边界这一观察，在前向不切分的前提下记录循环层输入的短窗口，并用跨层、仅状态的 replay kernel 重建目标状态，每 token 成本比完整重算低 6–37 倍;配合优先保留活跃锚点与已验证分支、把闲置检查点槽位借给注意力 KV cache 的保留策略。在多种混合架构与负载上，中位 TTFT 降低 16–89%(最高 8.9 倍),80% SLO 容量提升至多 1.73 倍，goodput 提升至多 4.26 倍，且相对近似 replay 方法在长上下文下保持精确精度。
arxiv.reason: 混合架构精确前缀缓存与推理系统优化，直接命中系统效率方向

arxiv.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
arxiv.abstract: Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding---while keeping the policy frozen. We cast harness evolution as an RL-style outer loop and instantiate it with GEPA, a reflective evolutionary optimizer. The resulting harness adapters require no GPU training, are loadable per vertical domain, and compose with weight-based RL. Experiments with Codev, a Claude Code-style coding agent, on SWE-bench Verified, OfficeBench, and Terminal-Bench show a consistent pattern: weight updates give the strongest single-path gains, harness evolution recovers most of those gains at a small fraction of the compute, and combining both paths is best overall. We also analyze a failure mode of SFT-based specialization---shortened reasoning chains and increased truncation---and argue that harness adapters avoid it by construction. Our results position harness evolution as a practical, non-destructive complement to weight updates for vertical agents.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越权重更新：演化 Agent Harness 实现领域特化
arxiv.summaryZh: 领域特化通常被当作权重更新问题：收集轨迹、跑 RL 或 SFT、部署新 checkpoint。这里研究一条互补路径——在冻结策略的前提下演化 agent harness（系统提示、工具 schema、技能库、规划脚手架），将其建模为 RL 式外循环并用反射式进化优化器 GEPA 实现；所得 harness adapter 无需 GPU 训练、可按垂直领域加载，并能与权重 RL 组合。在 Claude Code 风格的编程 agent Codev 上，SWE-bench Verified、OfficeBench、Terminal-Bench 一致显示：权重更新单路径增益最强，harness 演化以极小算力恢复其中大部分增益，两者结合整体最优；SFT 特化会出现推理链缩短与截断增多的失效模式，而 harness adapter 从构造上规避了它。
arxiv.reason: Harness 演化＋Agentic 外循环，直接命中 Agent 与代码智能方向

arxiv.title: Pro$^2$ Agent: Scientific Problem Probing for Autonomous AI R&D
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now autonomously conduct AI research by writing code and running experiments. They typically do so by iteratively optimizing a codebase, while ignoring the problem structure behind the task. This formulation is effective on simpler tasks, but on difficult problems it often gets stuck in the wrong solution region because the agent never explicitly represents its understanding of the problem. We introduce Pro$^2$ Agent, which shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase state to a Problem State: an explicit structure of what problems prevent success and which solutions are likely to address them. Pro$^2$ Agent initializes the Problem State through comprehensive analysis of available resources and constraints. It then performs targeted research to relate the identified problems to candidate solutions. Through controlled hypothesis testing, the agent updates the importance of a suspected problem or the benefit brought by a candidate solution. On the complete MLE-Bench, Pro$^2$ Agent matches the best reported medal rate (70.7%) under the standard 24-hour budget and reaches 76.0% with a 48-hour budget, the highest medal rate reported on the complete benchmark. It also achieves competitive performance on PostTrainBench. In addition, it produces research notes for each task that make the research process transparent and reusable by human researchers.
arxiv.titleZh: Pro$^2$ Agent：面向自主AI研发的科学问题探查
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有LLM科研智能体靠迭代优化代码库推进实验，缺少对问题结构的显式建模，在困难任务上容易卡在错误的解区域。Pro$^2$ Agent把自主AI研发的主要状态从代码库状态改为问题状态：显式刻画阻碍成功的障碍与可能有效的候选方案，先通过分析已有资源与约束初始化该状态，再做定向调研把问题与方案关联起来，并通过受控假设检验更新问题的重要性或方案的收益。在完整MLE-Bench上，24小时预算下达到70.7%的奖牌率，与已报告的最佳持平；48小时预算下达到76.0%，为完整基准上的最高记录，在PostTrainBench上同样表现有竞争力；同时它为每个任务产出的研究笔记使过程透明且可复用。
arxiv.reason: 自主AI研发智能体，问题状态建模新颖，MLE-Bench刷新纪录

arxiv.title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
arxiv.abstract: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal. However, privacy and local control motivate running agents on users' devices, where limited memory and compute favor smaller models and complicate on-device training.
