arxiv.titleZh: TwinLab-Bench:在真实实验室的智能体孪生中评估AI科学家
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对AI智能体自主设计实验这一最开放的能力，构建TwinLab-Bench:覆盖物理、化学、湿实验生物、材料与工程的52个任务、100余种实验动作，每个任务配一个TwinLab agent充当环境，读取真实实验室原始记录并调用基于记录构建的计算器，执行被测智能体设计的实验，再与隐藏的真实实验记录答案比对，并用闭卷探针排除凭记忆作答。前沿模型表现仍差，最强的Claude Fable 5.2平均仅45.0分，GPT-6.1-sol为31.7分，论文进一步实证分析其失败环节。该基准把「自设计实验」从选择题变成可执行、可核验的闭环评测，适用于科研智能体与Agentic RL的环境构建。
arxiv.reason: AI科学家智能体基准，命中科研智能体与评测方向，但属纯benchmark发布

arxiv.title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
arxiv.abstract: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale. Large language model (LLM) agents now write, test and improve code, but whether they can design algorithms that scale to realistic instances is open: in the FrontierOR benchmark's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matches Gurobi, with an objective within 1% of Gurobi's and no slower, on only 39% of the large instances. The FrontierOR Challenge asks teams to build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for many optimization problems at once. Stage 1 releases 60 of the benchmark's 180 audited problems, spanning six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15; Stage 2 introduces new problems outside the benchmark, with unseen instances. Two tracks are ranked separately: in the Main track we run the submitted algorithms in a network-isolated sandbox with open-source dependencies only; in the Self-hosted track teams solve the instances on their own machines, with any software, within a timed window. Every solution is checked for feasibility, and a feasible solution scores the ratio of its objective to a frozen known reference, averaged over hidden instances.
arxiv.titleZh: FrontierOR挑战赛：面向运筹学的Agentic算法设计
arxiv.summaryZh: 运筹学算法通常需专家针对每个新问题定制，耗时数周；LLM agent能否自主设计可扩展算法尚不清楚——在FrontierOR基准的一次性评测中，最强模型仅在39%的大规模实例上追平Gurobi（目标值差距1%以内且速度不慢）。挑战赛要求参赛队伍构建能同时为多个优化问题设计、测试并改进算法的Agent工作流：Stage 1从180道已审核题目中放出60道，覆盖六类应用与五种建模形式，每周发布15道；Stage 2引入基准之外的新问题与未见实例。赛道分为Main（网络隔离沙箱、仅限开源依赖）与Self-hosted（自备机器、软件不限、限时求解），所有解均做可行性校验，可行解按目标值与冻结参考解的比值在隐藏实例上平均计分。
arxiv.reason: Agentic算法设计基准与竞赛，方向相关但以赛题发布为主

arxiv.title: Same Judgement, Different Scores: Numerical Scoring Topology in LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as automated evaluators to reduce the cost and time required for human annotation. However, the role of scoring-scheme design in the reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation remains underexplored. To address this problem, we introduce numerical scoring topology, which characterizes the structural design of a scoring scheme in terms of its scale width, granularity, offset, symmetry, and boundary placement. Building on this definition, we conduct the first systematic study of how numerical scoring topology influences zero-shot LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation across diverse benchmarks and judge models. Our results show that numerical scoring topology systematically affects judge scores, calibration, and robustness, particularly in judgment-intensive evaluations. Shifted and narrow ranges tend to induce some of the largest score deviations across many settings. We further find that stronger and larger judge models generally achieve higher discriminative validity and greater robustness to scoring-topology changes. These findings suggest that numerical scoring topology should be treated as an integral component of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation and highlight the need for more principled and standardized scoring protocols.
arxiv.titleZh: 同样的判断，不同的分数：LLM-as-a-Judge 评测中的数值评分拓扑
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM-as-a-Judge 评测中评分量表的设计如何影响可靠性，此前缺乏系统考察。作者提出「数值评分拓扑」概念，用尺度宽度、粒度、偏移、对称性与边界位置五个维度刻画评分方案的结构设计，并在多个基准与多个裁判模型上开展首个系统性零样本研究。结果显示评分拓扑会系统性影响裁判给出的分数、校准与稳健性，在判断密集型任务上尤甚；偏移与窄区间在多数设定下引发最大分数偏差，而更强更大的裁判模型判别效度更高、对拓扑变化更稳健。结论是把评分拓扑视为 LLM-as-a-Judge 评测的有机组成，并推动更规范、标准化的评分协议。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-a-Judge 评分协议的系统性方法学研究，命中评测方向

arxiv.title: Understanding MoE Decisions Beyond Gradients
arxiv.abstract: Understanding a language model's decision requires knowing how its internal computations affect its preference between answers. Gradient-based methods estimate this influence by predicting the effect of changing those computations. In mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, replacing one expert can change which experts later layers select. Those switches can alter the answer scores in ways that derivatives do not capture. We introduce a predictor that uses the model's own expert outputs and selection rules to estimate these extra effects, then adds them to a second-order prediction. Across questions from three benchmarks, our method reduces the error in predicting answer-score changes by 60\% on Qwen3.6 and 47\% on Gemma4, relative to a multistep baseline using gradients and second derivatives.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越梯度：理解 MoE 的决策机制
arxiv.summaryZh: MoE 模型中替换单个专家会改变后续层的专家路由，使基于梯度的答案分数影响预测失效。为此提出一种预测器，利用模型自身的专家输出与选择规则估计这类路由切换带来的额外效应，并将其叠加到二阶梯度预测上。在三个 benchmark 的问题上，相对使用梯度与二阶导的多步基线，该方法将答案分数变化预测误差在 Qwen3.6 上降低 60%、在 Gemma4 上降低 47%。这为 MoE 内部计算的细粒度归因与可解释性提供了更准确的工具。
arxiv.reason: MoE 可解释性与路由分析，属架构方向，方法清晰

arxiv.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task. Since replacement is not always justified, we encourage researchers to test it for their task.
arxiv.titleZh: AltRA-Test：无需共享标注者的 LLM 评判器替代性检验
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决大规模标注中不同条目由不同标注者子集标注、因而无法直接套用原有替代标注者检验（Alt-Test）的问题。方法是对条目做 bootstrap 重采样，为每个条目抽取 k 个人类标注并用 LLM 标注替换其中一个，构造「全人类」与「人机混合」配对评审组，以混合组标注者间一致性（IAA）对全人类组非劣作为替代成立的判据，并证明该检验具有渐近水平 α 的一致性。在覆盖文本、图像、音频、视频的 20 个数据集上对 18 个 LLM 与 5 种提示技术实测，约 100 个条目即足够，模拟中比现有基线做出更多正确的替代决策，真实数据中约半数设置通过检验且主要取决于任务类型。为 LLM-as-judge 能否替代人工标注提供了可落地的统计判据。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge 评估可靠性方法学，直接命中评测方向

arxiv.title: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
arxiv.abstract: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, our grounded task interface improves Qwen3-4B's accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% on average without training. With learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% accuracy on average on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.
arxiv.titleZh: SheetAlign：面向电子表格 Agent 的接地交互与阶段隔离学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 在本地部署开源模型以自动化电子表格分析时，复杂任务既要推理又要理解工作簿结构，预定义操作接口还带来额外的工具选择负担。SheetAlign 按「在哪操作、改什么、怎么实现」组织流程：用任务引导的探查与 API 接地，把代码生成锚定在工作簿观测和可用操作上；再用阶段隔离的策略学习，以编辑进展奖励分别优化程序生成与审查；推理阶段通过多个工作簿状态之间的一致性来挑选程序。仅换用接地的任务接口、不做训练，Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上就从 13.5% 升到 29.2%；加上学习与执行一致性后平均准确率 32.8%，Domain-Spreadsheet 上为 30.1%，优于同类基线。
arxiv.reason: 电子表格 Agent，接地接口与阶段隔离学习，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
arxiv.abstract: Post-training low-rank compression of neural networks must not only approximate the original weights but also preserve the model's input-output behavior. Recent output-aware methods measure the compression error beyond the compressed layer, at the model output, weighting logit changes by the observed next token or by the model's predicted probabilities. We propose Complete-SVD, a method for large language models that minimizes the $L_2$ distance between the logits of the original and compressed models, weighting all logit changes equally. Linearizing the network around the original weights, together with a Kronecker-factored approximation, reduces this objective to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution. Its output-side factor is intractable to compute; we estimate it without bias from random probes, at a cost of $K$ backward passes per sequence, independent of vocabulary size and sequence length. At matched settings with uniform ranks and WikiText-2 calibration, Complete-SVD achieves the lowest C4 and PTB perplexity in every setting, and at ratio 0.7 under LEMS rank allocation. Replacing the $L_2$ distance by the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL-SVD), with the same estimation framework, lowers calibration perplexity in most settings and raises downstream accuracy, but raises cross-corpus perplexity. Complete-SVD also improves IFEval instruction-following accuracy over the strongest prior output-aware methods throughout.
arxiv.titleZh: Complete-SVD:一种面向低秩LLM压缩的函数范数方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 低秩后训练压缩不仅要逼近原始权重，还要保持模型的输入输出行为。Complete-SVD直接最小化原模型与压缩模型logits之间的L2距离，对所有logit变化等权;借助在原始权重处的网络线性化与Kronecker因子近似，该目标化为有闭式解的加权SVD，其中输出侧因子通过对随机探针的无偏估计得到，每条序列仅需K次反向传播，成本与词表大小、序列长度无关。在统一秩与WikiText-2校准的对照设置下，该方法在全部设置中取得最低的C4与PTB困惑度，并在LEMS秩分配、压缩比0.7时同样最优;将L2换成KL散度(KL-SVD)后在多数设置下降低校准困惑度并提升下游准确率，但跨语料困惑度上升。IFEval指令跟随准确率也全面优于此前最强的输出感知方法。
arxiv.reason: 低秩LLM压缩新目标函数，理论简洁且实验充分，属高效推理方向

embodied.title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
embodied.abstract: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.
embodied.titleZh: Awaken-HI：以全身人类经验扩展人形智能
embodied.summaryZh: 现有第一视角视频数据集缺少同步的全身运动数据，难以支撑大规模loco-manipulation学习。工作构建Awaken-Human数据集，将约5万小时第一视角立体视频与同步全身人体运动配对，覆盖100余项技能；并在此基础上提出VLA模型Awaken-HI，通过共享action expert同时预测原始人体运动与重定向后的机器人动作，使人类轨迹直接监督该模块。实验显示人类预训练数据增加会按经验scaling law降低留出集机器人动作预测误差，并提升真机下游任务成功率；全量预训练并在T800适配后，八个单项任务平均成功率达93.75%，在单项与长程评测中均优于GR00T N1.7与π0.5，且可泛化到未见物体及未见过的物体与目的地组合。
embodied.reason: 人形VLA旗舰技术报告，5万小时全身数据与scaling law，直击VLA训练方向

embodied.title: Alignment Drives Reuse: Learning Generalizable Robot-Use Agents from Heterogeneous Experience
embodied.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate broad generalization across tasks and domains. However, comparable generalization in robot manipulation remains challenging. Heterogeneity in robot embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. We rethink robot skill learning through alignment: Can heterogeneous interactions across benchmarks and embodiments jointly improve one shared skillset for robot manipulation? We propose UniCraft, a framework for learning robot manipulation skills by aligning heterogeneous settings. Specifically, UniCraft represents observed scene geometry using consistent coordinate conventions and aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots. It organizes tasks from different benchmarks in a canonical format, allowing interaction feedback to jointly refine shared skills and the orchestration policy that guides their selection and composition, without any demonstrations or model weight updates. We interleave tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments, collecting 2,700 learning rollouts per agent model. During training, UniCraft improves pooled task success on unseen scenarios and tasks by 9-28 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8-13.3 on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1-14.4 on RoboCasa365 (Epochs 1-3). After training, with the learned skills frozen, UniCraft demonstrates zero-shot transfer across 4 new robot embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.
embodied.titleZh: 对齐驱动复用：从异构经验中学习可泛化的机器人使用智能体
embodied.summaryZh: 跨benchmark与跨本体的交互经验因本体、任务表述、几何约定与动作接口不一致而割裂，机器人操作难以获得VLM级泛化。UniCraft用统一坐标约定表示场景几何，对齐各机器人的感知与控制接口，并把不同benchmark的任务组织为规范格式，使交互反馈在无示教、不更新权重的情况下同时改进共享技能库与负责技能选择、组合的编排策略。在3个benchmark、6种本体上各采集2700条rollout，训练1–3轮即在未见场景上提升9–28（LIBERO-PRO）、10.8–13.3（RoboTwin 2.0）、3.1–14.4（RoboCasa365）个百分点；冻结技能后可零样本迁移到4种新本体与5个新智能体模型。
embodied.reason: 机器人智能体框架＋跨本体对齐复用，直接命中具身智能体方向

embodied.title: CoachSI: Self-Improvement of Robot Policies with a Language Coach
embodied.abstract: Generalist robot policies execute atomic skills reliably but fail when the same skills are composed into long-horizon tasks. Self-improvement from the policy's own experience does not close this gap: experience collected by the policy alone stays within its own distribution and reproduces what it can already do. We show that what the policy lacks is not a skill but the next step. We present CoachSI, a self-improvement method in which a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) coaches the policy in language: it watches the robot and names the next step in the format of the policy's atomic instructions, and never outputs an action. Successful coached rollouts are relabeled in hindsight with the original task instruction and used to fine-tune the policy. The fine-tuned policy is then deployed on its own. On states where a World Action Model and a Vision-Language-Action model have stalled, naming the next step raises subgoal completion by 4.6x over the unchanged task instruction, and the frozen VLM supplies it from the same camera images the policy sees. After fine-tuning, unassisted success on long-horizon tasks in unseen scenes rises from 47.4% to 59.3%, 9.8 points above fine-tuning on human demonstrations and 7.3 points above fine-tuning on self-collected successes at an equal data budget. With a coach that sees only camera images, it reaches 56.8%, above both baselines. The gain is obtained with the action backbone frozen: language coaching teaches the policy what should happen next, and the skills it already has do the rest.
embodied.titleZh: CoachSI：以语言教练实现机器人策略的自我改进
embodied.summaryZh: 通用机器人策略能稳定执行原子技能，却难以把同样的技能组合成长程任务；仅靠自身经验自我改进无法跳出原有分布。CoachSI 让一个冻结的现成 VLM 充当「教练」，只观看机器人画面并以策略原子指令的格式说出下一步子目标、从不输出动作，成功片段再用原始任务指令做事后重标注并用于微调，微调后策略独立部署。在 World Action Model 与 VLA 模型卡住的状态上，命名下一步使子目标完成率提升 4.6 倍；未见场景长程任务无辅助成功率从 47.4% 升至 59.3%，在同等数据预算下分别高出人类示范微调 9.8 个点、自采集成功数据微调 7.3 个点，仅用相机图像的教练也达 56.8%。整个提升在动作主干冻结下取得，说明语言教练补的是「下一步做什么」，技能本身由策略已有能力完成。
embodied.reason: VLM 作语言教练驱动策略自我改进，直击具身后训练与智能体式机器人方向

embodied.title: LoCo-WAM: Test-Time Training as Long Context for World-Action Models
embodied.abstract: World-action models guide robot actions by predicting what happens next, but typically condition on a short observation history. Extending this history increases computation at every decision and can require a separately trained model. We introduce LoCo-WAM, which learns from the outcomes of its actions through test-time training while keeping the same short history length. It uses newly observed frames to update a low-rank adapter in the video expert, whose adapted predictions guide subsequent actions. The updates accumulate within each episode and are reset between episodes, allowing past observations to influence decisions after they leave the input window. LoCo-WAM thus learns from a longer stream of experience without expert action labels, additional data or meta-training. Experiments on two world-action models show improved task success across four simulation benchmarks. On RoboCasa GR-1, a model with 2.4,s of history matches one trained with 9.6,s, while a model with 4.8,s exceeds it by 4.8 percentage points. Our analysis shows that the updates improve prediction of upcoming frames, affect the action mainly through adaptation of the imagined future, and have an increasing effect on actions as the episode unfolds.
embodied.titleZh: LoCo-WAM：把测试时训练当作世界-动作模型的长上下文
embodied.summaryZh: 世界-动作模型靠预测未来帧来引导机器人动作，但通常只条件于很短的观测历史；要加长历史，每一步决策的计算量都会变多，而且可能得另训一个模型。LoCo-WAM 保持原有短历史长度不变，用新观测到的帧在测试时更新视频专家中的低秩适配器，由适配后的预测去引导后续动作；这些更新在单个 episode 内累积，在 episode 之间重置，于是已经移出输入窗口的过去观测仍能影响决策，且不需要专家动作标签、额外数据或元训练。在两个世界-动作模型、四个仿真基准上任务成功率均有提升：在 RoboCasa GR-1 上，历史为 2.4 s 的模型与用 9.6 s 历史训练的模型持平，历史为 4.8 s 的模型则高出 4.8 个百分点。分析显示，更新改善了未来帧预测，主要通过改变想象的未来来影响动作，且这种影响随 episode 推进不断增强。

embodied.title: Skill-JEPA: Learning Planner-Aligned Action Spaces for World Models
embodied.abstract: World models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn from pixels to predict the outcome of actions in a latent space. To reach a goal, a planner samples many candidate action sequences, uses the model to predict where each one leads, and executes the best one. However, standard planners draw their candidates from a Gaussian, while the model has only seen the structured, state-dependent actions of its training data. Its predictions for such candidates are unreliable, and planning fails more often as goals move farther away. We propose Skill-JEPA, which learns an action space aligned with the planner. A variational autoencoder conditioned on the current state encodes short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior, and decodes them back into actions. The world model predicts the effect of skills rather than raw actions, and the planner searches over skills starting from that same Gaussian, so its candidates resemble the model's training data. Skill-JEPA adds a single module, trained end-to-end with the world model, and leaves the planner untouched, with no subgoals, hierarchy, or hand-designed skills. Across three JEPA world models and four benchmarks, average success on goals 80 steps away rises from 42% with raw actions to 62%; the gains grow with goal distance and hold across four planners. On AntMaze, a quadruped locomotion task, success on goals two maze cells away rises from 0.4% to 38%. This suggests that part of the difficulty of reaching distant goals lies in the action space, and can be removed without changing the planner.
embodied.titleZh: Skill-JEPA：为世界模型学习与规划器对齐的动作空间
embodied.summaryZh: JEPA 类世界模型在潜空间中预测动作后果，但规划器从各向同性高斯采样候选动作序列，与训练中见过的结构化、随状态变化的动作分布不匹配，导致预测不可靠、远距离目标规划失败。Skill-JEPA 用状态条件 VAE 将短动作序列编码为带标准高斯先验的潜技能并解码回动作，世界模型改为预测技能的效果，规划器仍在同一高斯上搜索，因此无需子目标、分层结构或手工技能，也不改动规划器，仅增加一个与模型端到端训练的模块。在三个 JEPA 世界模型与四个基准上，80 步远目标的平均成功率从 42% 提升到 62%，增益随目标距离增大；在 AntMaze 上，两格远目标成功率从 0.4% 升至 38%。这表明远距离目标规划的部分困难源自动作空间本身，可在不改动规划器的前提下消除。

embodied.title: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
embodied.abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering visual information that is no longer observable, such as the original location of an object. Existing approaches typically rely on full observation histories, which become redundant over long horizons, or text summaries, which may omit precise visual details. We study visual moment memory, the ability to retain such details from key moments for subsequent manipulation. To support this study, we introduce VMBench, a suite of long-horizon manipulation tasks requiring memory of spatial locations, visual appearances, and their associations. We further propose MomentMem, a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM-based memorizer selects keyframes and an executor predicts actions conditioned on the selected memories. This separation enables us to evaluate memory selection alongside closed-loop task success and to study memorizer generalization independently of the executor. On VMBench, MomentMem achieves 49.9% average success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 31.7 percentage points. Moreover, we find that the memorizer transfers well to unseen appearances zero-shot. It can also adapt to an unseen task with only a few memory annotations, reaching 43.7% success, close to the 44.3% obtained with full memory supervision. Further experiments show competitive performance on RMBench and improvements in real-robot manipulation. These results highlight the value of retaining sparse visual evidence for memory-dependent manipulation. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MomentMem.
embodied.titleZh: MomentMem：为机器人操作记住关键时刻
embodied.summaryZh: 机器人操作常需记住已不可观测的视觉信息，现有方法或依赖冗余的完整观测历史，或用文本摘要丢失精确视觉细节。为此提出视觉时刻记忆任务与VMBench长程操作基准，覆盖空间位置、外观及其关联的记忆；并设计分层架构MomentMem，由基于VLM的记忆器挑选关键帧、执行器以所选记忆为条件预测动作，使记忆选择可与闭环成功率及记忆器泛化性分开评估。在VMBench上平均成功率达49.9%，超出最强基线31.7个百分点，记忆器可零样本迁移到未见外观，仅需少量记忆标注即可适配新任务（43.7%对全监督44.3%），在RMBench与真机上也具竞争力。

embodied.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
embodied.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
embodied.titleZh: AgentRoboCritic：理解前沿智能体在直接机器人控制上的能力
embodied.summaryZh: 前沿多模态智能体已能绕过高层原语、直接用底层数值动作控制机器人，但现有基准只报告 episode 级成功率，看不出成功从何而来、失败发生在哪里。AgentRoboCritic 让策略智能体在每个动作旁声明局部意图，由 critic 对照意图评估动作结果与失败模式，并在 12 个操作基准上做动作级分析：前沿智能体具备局部失败后的闭环恢复、跨场景语义 grounding 与零样本操作能力，但抓取、对齐等物理执行仍是瓶颈。工作释放 12,844 条标注动作数据集与微调 critic Muse-Glimmer-30B，失败模式准确率由 32.58% 升至 74.24%。
embodied.reason: 具身智能体的动作级评测框架与开源 critic，命中评测方法学方向

embodied.title: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
embodied.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.
embodied.titleZh: PhyDEX:基于动态外部灵巧操作的视觉-语言-动作模型物理推理基准
embodied.summaryZh: 现有VLA基准大多只考察夹爪与物体的接触，忽略重力、摩擦、惯性、质量分布等环境交互，难以判断策略是真懂物理还是在插值训练数据。PhyDEX以抛掷任务切入动态外部灵巧性:机器人需推断物体质量、质心与摩擦，把物体送到运动学工作空间之外。数据由抓取生成、运动规划与闭环抛掷优化组成的全自动流水线产出，含35K轨迹(143小时)、九个任务、100个场景，覆盖均匀、不规则与动态质量物体及静止、多目标、移动目的地。评测GR00T N1.7、DynamicVLA与ForceVLA，成功率均低于3%;给出真值物理参数后成功率约翻倍，暴露预训练鲁棒性不足与物理盲两个瓶颈。

embodied.title: ACE-Brain-0.7: Learning Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Embodied Agents
embodied.abstract: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.
embodied.titleZh: ACE-Brain-0.7:面向具身智能体的执行 grounded 推理学习
embodied.summaryZh: 长程具身任务要求模型的推理预测锚定在真实执行状态上，而现有 VLM 缺乏对执行进度的判断能力。工作构建 370 万问答对，监督信号取自第一视角人类视频、机器人 episode 与仿真，覆盖执行各阶段的任务理解、空间 grounding 与进度估计，并基于 Qwen3.5-9B 微调出 9B 模型 ACE-Brain-0.7。在六个公开任务推理基准上平均 76.5 分，超过 GPT-6 Astra 的 72.7 与 Claude Opus 5.5 的 73.5;七个空间 grounding 基准平均 75.90,RefCOCOg 上 Acc@0.5 达 91.25。受控实验显示仅训练任务数据的版本能更有效利用视觉历史、更准确区分执行状态，说明空间感知与时序理解可协同提升具身执行推理。

embodied.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
embodied.abstract: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.
embodied.titleZh: Mind2Act World：面向机器人操作中具身心智、物理动作与心智-动作组合的诊断基准
embodied.summaryZh: 现有具身基准或在同一任务里同时考察推理与执行，或分开测量而不看组合，难以判断失败来自推理、执行还是二者的衔接。Mind2Act World 构建 30 个仿真操作任务，配三级难度与 Clean/Random 场景共 180 种配置，分 Mind、Act、Mind2Act 三个视图，并用诊断 harness 把失败片段归因到推理、执行或组合，输出系统画像卡。评测多模态智能体、VLA 与 WAM 显示能力并不迁移：最强智能体在 Mind、Act 上成功率为 52.7% 与 39.0%，Mind2Act 仅 12.0%，它保得住任务状态却难维持持续接触，端到端策略则相反。
